VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)"` with `h` coming from user-configured site_settings (`embeddable_hosts` values). A host value containing a quote would break/alter the SQL; the mechanism is verifiable directly in the diff.

adjudication.rationale: In `db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb`, the migration inserts each prior `embeddable_hosts` line using raw string interpolation: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)"`. If any stored host value contains a single quote, the SQL becomes invalid and the migration can fail. Additionally, because the value comes from the `site_settings` table (admin-provided but still unescaped input), it is injected into SQL without escaping/parameterization.
